call_points.text: Secured a $138 million full vehicle program with a leading luxury European automotive OEM.
Reiterated confidence in delivering strong double-digit growth for the full year.
Signed a $100 million five-year Tenneco partnership covering engineering, digital and business process transformation.
A leading Japanese automotive OEM selected the company for a full vehicle engineering program, a scaled entry into Japan.
A European luxury OEM gave a multi-year engagement across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, purchasing and IDT.
Cash and cash equivalents fell to $118.7 million from $195.5 million in Q4FY26.
Free cash flow was ₹247.9 Cr in Q1FY27, up from ₹234.9 Cr in Q4FY26.
DSO (billed plus unbilled) rose to 97 days from 87 a year ago and 95 in Q4FY26.
Voluntary LTM attrition was 16.0%, down from 16.2% in Q4FY26 and up from 13.8% a year ago.
Offshore share of revenue was 66%, down from 67% in Q4FY26 and up from 60% a year ago.
FY27 organic revenue growth guided at double digits in constant currency, excluding ES-Tec.
call_points.versus_prior: reiterated the double-digit organic growth target from the Q4FY26 call

call_points.text: Four large deals closed in Q4 and two more in April, including a European luxury OEM PLM deal and a Japanese OEM Full Vehicle Program.
Q4 EBITDA margin 16%, up about 200 bps QoQ, on volume and operating leverage.
Aerospace revenue at over $40 million annual run rate, up 8x in four years, with Airbus the flagship account.
Top 20 customers now make up almost 88% of the business.
Middle East crisis could tighten customer discretionary spend if it extends, but management says it is factored into guidance.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,572.22 Cr (+22.3% YoY), net profit ₹204.17 Cr (+8.1% YoY).
Tata Technologies reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,572.22 Cr with an operating EBITDA margin of 16.0%.
Tata Technologies' Q4FY26 earnings call guided FY27 double-digit organic growth and an exit operating margin above 18%, after Q4 revenue of ₹1,572 Cr and EBITDA margin of 16%.
On 18 May 2026, Tata Technologies was named Frost & Sullivan's 2026 Asia-Pacific Company of the Year in Autonomous Vehicle Engineering.
Tata Technologies secured SAP PartnerEdge Sell authorization across India and the US to strengthen enterprise transformation capabilities.
On June 3, 2026, Tata Technologies filed its FY26 Annual Report and notice for its 32nd AGM scheduled on June 26, 2026.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,698.8 Cr (+28.4% YoY), net profit ₹171.44 Cr.
On October 14, 2026, Tata Technologies reported Q2FY27 revenue of ₹1,698.8 Cr, up 28.4% YoY, and announced a $138 million deal win.
Tata Technologies Limited shared the audio recording of its earnings conference call on unaudited standalone and consolidated results for Q2FY27 and H1FY27, held October 14, 2026, via its website.
